summary: Healthy Choice Wellness Corp. (HCWC) filed an 8-K on May 27, 2026, announcing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger whereby its wholly owned subsidiary, Merger Sub, will merge with and into Host Digital Infrastructure LLC, a vertically-integrated digital infrastructure platform. Host Digital unitholders will receive shares of HCWC Class A common stock or pre-funded warrants. The filing does not disclose specific financial terms such as price per share, premium, or implied value. No board recommendation or named advisors are mentioned. The merger is structured as a stock-for-units transaction, with Host Digital surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of HCWC. Watch for regulatory approvals and stockholder vote; risk-arb spread depends on HCWC's stock volatility.
